author: Izzi686
title: More non premium features
content: Please add music vids for non premium members and allow us to not shuffle play. On my phone for some reason I can’t shuffle play with just a playlist and I always get recommended music that I don’t want to listen to. If I wanted to listen to it I would just listen to it. Let me listen to my playlists in peace. Otherwise it is a very good and accessible app.

author: JustMeIMyself
title: Getting Greedy
content: Personally I used to love Spotify, but I feel like each time they update they just take more and more away from no premium users. They recently made it so you can only skip so many times an hour then also added playing different songs as wanted in premium. I feel like Spotify is just trying to take more and more away just so they can have more.
